newsitem.title: INDONESIA: Indonesia JIHD to issue 600 bln rph bonds.
newsitem.headline: Indonesia JIHD to issue 600 bln rph bonds.

text.p: Indonesian hotel owner and property developer PT Jakarta International Hotels & Development (JIHD) said on Tuesday it plans to raise 600 billion through a five-year straight bonds issue next month.
The company said coupons, payable semi-annually, would range between 15.85 and 16.25 percent per annum.

It said 35 percent of the funds raised would be used for long-term debt repayment, 20 percent for short-term debt repayment, 35 percent for bridge-financing on subsidiary firms and 10 percent for increasing working capital.
The bonds, rated BBB- with a positive outlook by Indonesian rating agency Pefindo, would be offered from July 7 to 9 and be listed on July 22.
Lead underwriters for the issue are PT Danareksa Sekuritas and PT Trimegah Securindolestari.
JIHD, which also has an indirect stake of 21.4 percent in the local telecommunications company PT Satelindo, said business prospects remained strong in 1997 and 1998.
The firm said international telephone traffic was forecast to grow by about 70 percent in 1997.

It said operating profit margins from the hotel business would improve after the re-opening of its Jakarta property in the third quarter and expected strong contribution from the property sector as two-thirds of its apartment sales are yet to be booked.
